libarchive.js 2.0.2 (npm "libarchive.js", https://github.com/nika-begiashvili/libarchivejs)
Files: libarchive.js, worker-bundle.js, libarchive.wasm, copied unchanged from the
package's dist/ folder (sha256 in OROS_BIBLE.md, Library section).
Used by orOS Library only to open CBR (RAR) comics; loaded on demand, never for
other books.

The JavaScript wrapper is under the MIT License (LICENSE in this folder,
Copyright (c) 2018 Nika Begiashvili).

The WebAssembly module and the worker bundle also contain:

- libarchive 3.7.2, https://www.libarchive.org/

  contributors. Its RAR 4 and RAR 5 readers are libarchive's own code (not
  the UnRAR source).
